title: Welcome to Low Voltage Canada: Our Industry, Our Stories
excerpt: I started Low Voltage Canada to help our industry share its work, discover products and opportunities, and connect. This is a place for the people building a more connected Canada.
seoTitle: Welcome to Low Voltage Canada | A Note from the Founder
seoDescription: Meet Low Voltage Canada, a new publication for products, people, companies, integrator projects, events, insights and job opportunities across our industry.

sections.text: Welcome to Low Voltage Canada. I’m Arjun, and I created this publication to help the people working in Canada’s low-voltage industry share what they do and discover what’s happening around them.

Low-voltage work connects so much of everyday life: the networks we rely on, the AV systems that bring people together, the security systems that protect our spaces, and the technology making buildings smarter. Behind those systems are integrators, technicians, manufacturers, distributors, designers, and many others whose work deserves attention.
Why I started Low Voltage Canada

I wanted a Canadian space for the products, people, companies, projects, and conversations shaping our industry. A place where an integrator can discover a useful solution, a company can introduce its work, and someone starting out can learn about the people and opportunities around them.
Low Voltage Canada brings those stories into one place. We’re just getting started, and I want the publication to grow through the experiences and contributions of the people doing the work.
What we’ll highlight
Products: new technology and the practical problems it addresses, across AV, security, networking, and smart buildings.
People: the technicians, leaders, designers, and teams behind the systems we use every day.
Companies: company spotlights, new developments, and the businesses contributing to our industry.
Integrators: real projects, installation challenges, and the thinking behind a successful system.
Events and insights: opportunities to meet, learn, and share perspectives on what’s happening around us.
Job opportunities: a way to help employers share openings and people discover their next step in the industry.
Be part of the story

Have a project you’re proud of? A product worth introducing? A company, person, event, or job opening the industry should know about? I’d love to hear from you. You don’t need a polished press release. Start with what you’re working on, why it matters, and what you’d like to share.

[Follow Low Voltage Canada on LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/company/143923307/) and [join our LinkedIn group](https://www.linkedin.com/groups/18411050/) to stay connected, contribute ideas, and take part in the conversation.
Help us build Low Voltage Canada
Running and growing this publication takes time and support. I’m welcoming Bronze Sponsors and Publication Partners who want to help keep Low Voltage Canada going.
Bronze Sponsor · Contact for pricing
Support the publication and discuss sponsor recognition, a link to your company, and agreed placements. Let’s find an arrangement that fits your goals.
Publication Partner · Contact for pricing

Explore a broader collaboration around product highlights, company visibility, project showcases, or hiring campaigns. We’ll discuss the scope and pricing together. Paid promotions will be clearly identified as sponsored.

For sponsorship pricing, collaboration, or a story you’d like to share, email [arjun@lowvoltagecanada.com](mailto:arjun@lowvoltagecanada.com). You can also [explore our sponsorship options](/#sponsor).
Thanks for being here at the beginning. I look forward to sharing your work and building Low Voltage Canada with you.
— Arjun, Founder, Low Voltage Canada
